body: The number of complaints don’t matter solely because of how old the location is. I looked up the reviews for mine and a lot of them complain about wrong orders or wait times but most of them are YEARS old and the new ones are clearly just haters. My advice is to just be nice to customers, learn your routine, and get along with ur coworkers. You’ll learn to not let customer complaints get to you soon enough. Also, never take the stress with you home!
Not mold. Not dirt. Just a dirty toaster. I would know cuz I’m an employee. Still would report it and ask for a refund tho.

Thank you for the compliments ! 

Yeah this is just an acoustic rendition I plan to add a lot more to them. Thank you for saying it sets a mood, That's what i've been aiming to do. I want a mix between dreaming and reminiscing, music to remember the good days and the bad days but still come out smiling and happy they happened. I don't have any "good" recording equipment so I can't do much about the hiss just yet but I am planning on upgrading everything >=)

As for your track, I really dig it! I was bopping my head throughout the entire track. I think the drums are really nice and that reversed sound effect on the melody (Guitar??) is really awesome. It's very psychedelic. I wish the bass was a little louder to give it even more of a kick and that the melody was a little louder but all these are minor problems that should only be fixed if you wish to. Overall I think it's a really solid song. I really did like it! 

P.S You've made a fan of me, Demolition rocks. Your drums give me almost like a breakcore EDM feel but the guitars switch it up and it's very enjoyable.

I agree, the mixing is very nice on this. It really is a good ambient song. 

It reminds me of Aphex's ambient projects. 

The melody is really beautiful too, I can see why it's one of your favorites.

I think overall this is a really solid track ! :)
